title: add-benchmark-lab-multi-variant-reporting-and-profiling-pipeline-v61
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Adds a new multi-variant reporting + profiling pipeline (v61) to Benchmark Lab. Includes runner configs, profiling baselines, and dashboards. No breaking changes.
description:
Context: This PR adds the v61 multi-variant reporting and profiling pipeline to benchmark-lab. Motivation is to support mixed-variant experiments (quantized vs fp16 vs compiled kernels) across representative workload runners and produce consistent profiling baselines and per-variant reporting for the Performance team and downstream dashboards.

What this PR contains:
- pipeline/bench_v61_dag.py: new Airflow DAG that orchestrates workload runners, profiling collectors, and report aggregation.
- runners/multi_variant_runner.py: unified runner that launches representative workloads with variant matrix support (model_variant, batch_size, seq_len).
- profiling/baselines/v61/*.json: new baseline artifacts produced from nightly runs (placeholders committed for CI-driven baseline acceptance tests).
- ci/benchmark_e2e.yml: lightweight e2e GH Actions workflow to validate the DAG and runners on small synthetic workloads.
- dashboards/bench_v61_dashboard.json: Datadog dashboard template to surface per-variant latency/throughput and memory profiles.
- docs/benchmark-lab/v61.md: usage and troubleshooting notes for the new pipeline.

Commits (summary):
- 7f3b2a1 Add initial DAG and orchestration primitives
- a21d9f4 Implement multi-variant runner and variant matrix config
- c8b4e5d Add profiling baseline artifacts and baseline acceptance test
- d4f1b7e Update CI workflow and add small e2e runner
- e6a3c9b Add dashboard template and documentation

Files changed (high level):
- pipeline/bench_v61_dag.py (new) -- core DAG that wires runners -> profilers -> reporter
- runners/multi_variant_runner.py (new) -- CLI + config to run matrix experiments
- profiling/baselines/v61/*.json (new) -- committed canonical baselines for CI comparisons
- ci/benchmark_e2e.yml (new) -- CI job to exercise the pipeline quickly
- dashboards/bench_v61_dashboard.json (new) -- dashboard JSON for Datadog
- docs/benchmark-lab/v61.md (new) -- shortstart and troubleshooting
- tests/benchmark/test_multi_variant_runner.py (new) -- unit tests for runner config parsing

Testing and CI:
- GH Actions job `benchmark-e2e` runs the airflow DAG in a lightweight local mode and executes the multi-variant runner on a tiny synthetic model. The job initially failed on first run due to file permission in the runner temporary directory; fixed in d4f1b7e and re-run.
- Unit tests and linters are green. Profiling baseline acceptance test is intentionally conservative (delta thresholds) to avoid CI flakiness.
- Nightly pipeline (Airflow) will pick up the DAG after this merge; baselines committed are seeds and will be replaced by production runs the first night.

Review conversation (high level):
- Priya Rao: "Nice layout. Two asks: 1) make the baseline JSONs smaller (they were large blobs) and 2) add a note in docs about when baselines should be regenerated."
- Author (Ava): "Shrunk the baseline artifacts to quantized summaries and added regeneration section in docs (see docs/benchmark-lab/v61.md)."
- Liam O'Connor: "Can we add an opt-in flag so Dedicated infra tests don't run the full matrix by default?"
- Author: "Added `--variants` and `--max-concurrency` CLI flags; CI uses `--variants minimal`."
- Ethan Martinez: "CI e2e failing on first run; rerun after fix and all green."
- Priya: "Approving, left one minor comment on logging format (non-blocking)."

Merge outcome:
- Merged via squash-merge to main. Merge notes: "Add benchmark-lab multi-variant reporting & profiling pipeline (v61) — squash merge by Priya Rao"

Notes for operators:
- To enable on Airflow, copy pipeline/bench_v61_dag.py to the cluster DAGs directory and ensure `BENCHMARK_S3_BUCKET` secret is set. Nightly job will populate `profiling/baselines/v61/` with canonical artifacts; treat the committed JSONs as seeds for the first run.

Related work: ENG-9876 tracks making baseline updates automatic; PM-452 defines required dashboard metrics for release. Linked support ticket SUP-321 requests multi-variant reporting for a customer POC.
notes: Pipeline added behind feature flag; seeded baselines committed. Operators should monitor first-night run and open ENG-9876 follow-ups for baseline regressions.
changelog_entry: Added multi-variant benchmark lab pipeline (v61) with profiling baselines and reporting dashboard. No breaking changes.
manual_steps: 1) Deploy pipeline/bench_v61_dag.py to Airflow DAGs. 2) Ensure BENCHMARK_S3_BUCKET env var and service account have write access. 3) Run `runners/multi_variant_runner.py --variants minimal --output s3://<bucket>/bench/v61/seed/` to seed baselines.
